GITHUB_TOKEN.verdict: WRONG TYPE — pipeline reads GITHUB_TOKEN; must be mapped from GH_TOKEN before publication

added_constants: FINE_GRAINED_TOKEN_ERROR_MESSAGE (actionable error with GH_TOKEN mapping instruction)
added_functions: classify_token_type(token) -> str — pure function, no I/O
check_classic_token(token) -> (bool, str) — fails closed on fine-grained PAT

error_message_content: Classic PAT with repo scope required; fine-grained token is not accepted. Fine-grained PATs (prefix 'github_pat_') cannot write to org-owned repos via the Git Data API (HTTP 403 on /git/blobs). Store a classic PAT (prefix 'ghp_', repo scope) in GH_TOKEN and map it: $env:GITHUB_TOKEN = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('GH_TOKEN', 'User')
publication_verdict: BLOCKED_WRONG_TOKEN_MAPPED — GH_TOKEN has correct classic PAT but GITHUB_TOKEN is currently fine-grained. Map GH_TOKEN to GITHUB_TOKEN before publication.
